pm.seasoning: 5 dummy wafers run after the clean

claims.statement: PM-800 was wet clean wall buildup removed and seasoning was 5 dummy wafers run after the clean, pre-PM recipe time was 61.58 s and baseline recipe time for clean chamber is 60.0 s so old recipe will run thick

PM-183 was wet clean with 5 dummy wafers run and had first wafers vs later 0.24 A and thickness slope -0.07 A per lot, while PM-219 with skipped seasoning had -10.98 A first wafers vs later, so with seasoning after PM-800 no thin start and no drift expected
Matching check shows MET02 reads 500.01 A on 500.0 A reference and MET02 minus MET01 is -0.38 A so no metrology correction needed
Two monitors combined give rate 8.4062 A per s requiring 59.48 s for 500 A which is -3.41 pct vs pre-PM and the pre-PM time would give 517.65 A which is above spec

release.summary: DEP01-B wet clean restored rate. Two seasoned monitors confirm rate 8.41 A per s, new time 59.48 s centers 500 A, old 61.58 s would be out of spec thick. No new parts so no fast thinning, EWMA 0.3 with no extra drift keeps control.
